criteria.text: Calculates the underwriting commission as $12,250,000 (7.0% of gross proceeds of $175,000,000) and identifies that the stated $10,412,500 is wrong.
Identifies that the comfort letter cut-off of 14 May 2026 is 12 days before the 26 May 2026 pricing date, outside the 3-business-day requirement in Clause 7(b), so a bring-down letter is needed.
Identifies that the Underwriting Agreement lacks selling restrictions (e.g. Rule 144A / Regulation S for the US, prospectus exemptions for Canada and the EEA) and recommends adding them.
Identifies that the Use of Proceeds allocations sum to $158,000,000, not the stated net proceeds of $150,000,000 (a $8,000,000 overstatement).
Shows the commission arithmetic (12,500,000 x $14.00 = $175,000,000; x 7.0% = $12,250,000) and flags the discrepancy.
States the gap between cut-off and pricing as a duration (12 calendar days) and identifies the latest compliant cut-off date.
Gives a pinpoint citation (document name and section/clause number) for every issue or finding.
